title: This extension fixes the broken portal
scenario: A support article shared in chat says a browser extension fixes a compatibility problem with a critical vendor portal. The extension asks to read and change data on all websites.

answers.A: Verify the extension and fix with IT/security or the vendor’s official documentation before installing it.
answers.B: Use a managed browser or approved workaround until IT validates the extension.
answers.C: Install it because the portal is business-critical and the extension has many positive reviews.

explanation: Extensions can read sessions, forms and credentials across sites. Popularity and urgency are not sufficient approval.
proTip: A browser extension can become a silent employee with access to every tab.
